entries.what: Indigenous Peoples' Day, schools closed. Grace sleeps in a little, then drives Lola Cora to the Vinca drugstore and does laundry at home on Tamarisk Court.
Spends the afternoon planning the flame test inquiry lab for Thursday's observation, sketching the stations at the kitchen table.
Watches the evening teleserye with Lola Cora; Ramón is on his 24-hour dispatch shift, so Grace handles dinner and Isabel's homework nagging.
entries.outcome: Quiet night, Isabel stays in her room.

entries.what: Tuesday 5:45 a.m. boardwalk walk at Ulloa Salt Marsh with Dana, then teaches periods 1, 2 and 3 including Dulce's class.
entries.outcome: Walk and morning classes went smoothly.

entries.what: Runs the Tuesday lunch lab-makeup session in B12, then uses prep to gather flame test supplies: splints, salts and goggles.
entries.outcome: Supplies counted; budget stayed under limit.

entries.what: Teaches periods 5 and 6, then cooks dinner and checks in with Lola Cora about her evening routine.
Teaches the morning sections and eats leftover rice and ulam in B12 during prep, rehearsing the observation lesson aloud.
entries.outcome: Lesson timing trimmed to fit period 2.

entries.what: Picks up Lola Cora's prescriptions at the Vinca Avenue drugstore after school, then sorts the pills into the organizer.
Prints the lab handouts and has a short argument with Isabel over her late-night essay drafting.
Patricia Ocampo observes Grace's period 2 with the full flame test inquiry lab she prepared specially for the visit; Grace had asked for three differentiation tweaks for it.
entries.outcome: Lesson ran on time and students were engaged.

entries.what: Eats lunch in B12 with Dana, who has been venting about her own evaluations, and they debrief the observation.
entries.outcome: Dana reassured Grace it went well.

entries.what: Teaches periods 5 and 6, then takes a Thursday dawn-walk follow-up call from Dana about the weekend plans; evening is spent grading lab reports.
Teaches her five sections and submits the Friday form with her spreadsheet template at 3:30.
Hears from Dana at lunch that the district is reassigning IT help, and that the observation notes from Patricia will come next week.
Takes the hatchback to the Ruel Road station to fill up cheaply, then orders pancit for dinner since she is too tired to cook.
Saturday grocery run at Ruiz Family Market and rolls from Panadería Las Hermanas.
Works in the backyard on the calamansi and tomato pots while Lola Cora watches from the porch.
Pays bills and reviews the car loan and the month's budget on the laptop, worrying about the first payment.
Attends Tagalog Mass at 9 at Our Lady of the Marsh with Lola Cora, then has lunch.
Grades at the kitchen table, rewriting a parent email three times to soften it, then fires off a one-line text to Isabel reading 'Dishes. Now.'
entries.outcome: Isabel stops talking to her; Grace wonders only afterward whether the text was too harsh.

entries.what: Evening quiet in the house; Grace sits with Lola Cora and the teleserye and thinks about apologizing to Isabel.
